en.text: If you eat at this time of night, you'll get fat.

original: 体調はいつもけっこういいんだけど、ちょっと今太っちゃってるんだ。

en.text: I'm usually in pretty good shape, but now I'm a little overweight.

original: このドレス、太って見えるかな？

en.text: Does this dress make me look fat?

original: このドレスだと太って見える？

en.text: Does this dress make me look fat?

original: 私は太っている。

en.text: I'm fat.

original: 俺、太ってるかな？

en.text: Am I fat?

original: トムって太りすぎだと思う。

en.text: I think Tom is overweight.
I think that Tom is overweight.

original: 食べすぎると太るよ。

en.text: If you eat too much, you'll become fat.
If you eat too much, you will get fat.

original: この夏は2キロ太った。

en.text: I have put on two kilograms this summer.
I gained two kilos this summer.

indices: 此の{この} 夏(なつ) は キロ 太る{太った}

original: あの猫はかなり太ってる。

en.text: That cat is quite fat.

original: アメリカに行ったら、たくさん太った。

en.text: When I went to the US, I gained weight.

original: あの太った魔女は世界で一番綺麗であるかの如く振る舞っているのを見ると笑わなくてはいられない。

en.text: I can't help but laugh when I see that fat witch behaving as if she were the prettiest in the whole world.

original: あのドレスを着ると君は太っているように見えるよ。

en.text: That dress makes you look fat.

original: トムは今よりすごい太っていた。

en.text: Tom used to be a lot fatter than he is now.

original: また太っちゃった。

en.text: I've gained weight again.

original: 私、太ってる？

en.text: Do you think I'm fat?

original: 彼は太りすぎよ。

en.text: He is overweight.
He's too fat.

original: 太っちゃった。

en.text: I have gained weight.

original: 高校のとき太ってた？

en.text: Were you fat when you were in high school?

original: 太って見えるよ。

en.text: You look fat.

original: トムが太りすぎだと思っているのは私だけじゃない。

en.text: I'm not the only one who thinks Tom is overweight.

original: 太りすぎだったの？

en.text: Were you overweight?

original: トムは太りすぎだと本当に思ってる？

en.text: Do you really think Tom is overweight?

original: 何でトムってあんなに太ってるんだろう。

en.text: I wonder why Tom is so fat.

original: 太りたいの？

en.text: Do you want to put on weight?

original: 彼女、太ったね。

en.text: She gained weight.

original: 彼、太ったね。

en.text: He gained weight.

original: 彼女、太ってきたね。

en.text: She is gaining weight.
She's gotten fat.
She's gained weight.

original: トム、太ってきたね。

en.text: Tom is gaining weight.

original: トム、太ったね。

en.text: Tom gained weight.

original: 君、太ってないよ。

en.text: You're not fat.
You aren't fat.

original: 君って、太ってるの？

en.text: Are you fat?

original: トムは子供の頃、少し太り気味でした。

en.text: Tom was a little overweight when he was a child.
Tom was a little overweight when he was a kid.

original: トムはメアリーほど太ってないよ。

en.text: Tom isn't as fat as Mary.

original: 白い太った猫が塀の上に座って、彼を疲れた目で見た。

en.text: The plump white cat sat on top of the wall, looking at him with exhausted eyes.
The plump white cat sat on top of the wall and looked at him with exhausted eyes.

original: 食べたいだけ食べても太らない方法ってないかなあ。

en.text: I wonder if there's a way to eat as much as I want without putting on weight.

original: あの人って、ガリガリだけど、奥さんは太ってるのよ。

en.text: That man is skinny, but his wife is fat.

original: 夜中にポテチなんか食べたら、太るよ。

en.text: If you eat stuff like potato chips in the middle of the night, you'll get fat.

original: いくら食べても、太らないのよ。

en.text: No matter how much I eat, I never get fat.

original: 太らないようにね。

en.text: Don't get fat.
Don't put on weight.

original: 「トム久しぶり！ ちょっと太った？」「うん、最近全然運動できてないんだ」

en.text: "Tom! It's been a while. Haven't you put on a little weight?" "Yeah, I haven't been able to get any exercise done at all lately."

original: 外に出れないから、運動不足で太っちゃう。

en.text: I'm not able to go outside, so I've put on weight due to a lack of exercise.

original: 太っている人は大抵汗かきだ。

en.text: Fat people generally sweat a lot.

original: あの子、１０年前は今より太ってたのよ。

en.text: She was fatter ten years ago than she is now.

original: パンを食べると太るって、本当？

en.text: Is it true that eating bread will make you fat?

original: いくら食べても太らない人、羨ましいなぁ。

en.text: I'm jealous of people that can eat as much as they want and not get fat.

original: 太りたくない。

en.text: I don't want to get fat.

original: そんなに食べてたら、太るよ。

en.text: If you keep eating like that, you're going to get fat.

original: トムは前ほど太ってないよ。

en.text: Tom isn't as fat as he was before.

original: トムはそんなに太ってないよ。

en.text: Tom's not very fat.
Tom isn't very fat.

original: トムは、あまり太ってないよ。

en.text: Tom's not very fat.
Tom isn't very fat.

original: 背は低くて、太ってる。

en.text: She's short and fat.

original: お前の猫、太りすぎだって。

en.text: Your cat is too fat.

original: トムは太りすぎよ。

en.text: Tom's too fat.
Tom is too fat.

original: 大問題といえば、今太っているという事じゃなくて、30キロ軽かった時と同じ調子、基本的に同じ速さで全てのことをこなしてることなんです。それが、この体に大きなストレスとしてのしかかってるんです。

en.text: The big problem is not that I'm fat now, but that I'm doing everything with the same rhythm, basically with the same speed as when I was 30 kilos lighter. And it puts a lot of stress on my body.

original: ちょっと太ったみたいだね。

en.text: It looks like you've put on some weight.
It looks like you've gained a little weight.
You seem to have gained some weight.
You seem to have put on some weight.

original: 私が太るのは、甘い物を沢山食べるからだ。

en.text: I'm starting to gain weight after eating so many sweet things.

original: 太ってはないよ。ちょっと、ぽっちゃりしてるだけで。

en.text: She's not fat – she's just a little plump.

original: ここに来てから2キロ以上太っちゃった。

en.text: I've gained over five pounds since I got here.
I've gained over two kilograms since coming here.
I've gained over two kilograms since I got here.
I've gained more than two kilos since I came here.
I've gained more than two kilos since I got here.

original: ご飯は太るから、食べ過ぎないようにね！

en.text: Rice makes you fat, so don't eat too much of it!

original: おからドーナツはヘルシーだからとたくさん食べてしまい太る。

en.text: People eat a lot of okara donuts because they are healthy and still end up gaining weight.
I eat lots of okara donuts because they're healthy, and I still end up gaining weight.

original: 背の高さは１７０センチほどで、目が大きく、やや太っている。

en.text: He's around 170 centimeters tall with big eyes and a bit of chub.
He's about 170 cm tall with big eyes, and is slightly chubby.
The height is about 170 centimeters, with large eyes and a somewhat overweight build.
She's about 170 cm tall with big eyes, and is slightly chubby.
She's around 170 centimeters tall with big eyes and a bit of chub.
They're about 170 centimeters tall with big eyes and a bit of chub.
The height is about 5 feet 7 inches, with big eyes and a slightly overweight build.

original: 太ってません。

en.text: I'm not fat!

original: 子供の頃は、太ってました。

en.text: I was fat when I was a kid.
